messages:
Mia Chen: Quick heads-up — drafting the go-live blog for Redwood Optimize + Dedicated. Need a quick content pass (tone + CTA) and signoff on the benchmark claims. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/GO-LIVE-DRAFT
Ryan Patel: On it. Dropping comments now. Where's the benchmark deck?
Mia Chen: Benchmark deck v3 in the doc (link above) and raw numbers in the spreadsheet. Key claims: 2.3x throughput vs baseline, ~35% token cost reduction using caching + quantization. Please flag anything that needs a caveat.
Devon Lee: 2.3x is OK if we call out the test setup. Add a short parenthetical: "measured on 8x A100, seq_len=512, batch=8". Also avoid absolutes like "always".
Sophia Gomez: CTA options: A) Try the demo B) Join the webinar C) Request dedicated. Recommend A/B test A vs B on blog. Short CTAs: "Try it free" vs "See it in action".
Tara Nguyen: Webinar slot proposal — Wed Jun 16, 11am PT. I'll create the invite + landing page. Who are speakers?
Mia Chen: Speakers: Ryan (Product), Devon (Infra), Priya Rao (Customer Success). Ryan, can you do 2 slides that summarize the benchmark methodology?
Ryan Patel: Yep. I'll prep 2 slides and a 30s talking script for the webinar segment.
Mia Chen: Lead routing plan: blog form -> HubSpot capture -> route enterprise leads to SDR queue "enterprise"; SMB to "growth". Use UTM for tracking: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=go-live-q2`.
Devon Lee: Also add a hidden boolean field in the form `benchmark_interested=true` when they click the "See benchmark" CTA. That'll let us route high-intent leads to the demo team.
Sophia Gomez: Copy tweak: add a sentence about graceful degradation with model variants/fallback — customers care about reliability. Put it in the second paragraph.
Mia Chen: Good — adding that now.
Legal Bot: Quick scan complete. The term "SLA" appears twice. If marketing implies an SLA commitment, we need legal/ops signoff. Otherwise I can approve non-contractual language and the benchmark wording as long as methodology is linked.
Mia Chen: We'll remove SLA phrasing and link to methodology appendix.
Ryan Patel: PR plan rough: publish blog -> newsletter email -> social -> paid promos -> webinar landing with gated CTA. Target publish: Tue Jun 15.
Tara Nguyen: I'll lock webinar CTA + landing copy by Friday. Need final assets from design and the 2 slides.
Mia Chen: @Olga (Design) can you mock 2 hero image variants and a small benchmark infographic by Thursday? Figma link preferred.
Olga (Design): Sure — will create mocks and drop them in the Figma file.
Devon Lee: One more ops note: save raw test logs and upload a summarized annex (spreadsheet + short methods blurb) to the doc so we can defend the numbers if asked.
Mia Chen: Agreed. I'll attach the annex. If no objections, I'll merge this draft and request legal signoff by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
Sophia Gomez: No objections from me.
Tara Nguyen: :calendar: Webinar invite created and calendar shared — will post landing link when ready.
Mia Chen: Thanks everyone — will ping again once legal signoff is in.
